🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 8, 2026

Moon, in its fall in Scorpio, holds a conjunction to Mercury, without title in the same sign. Two water placements agreeing on the terms: the thing and its worth sit on top of one another today.

Easier — Deciding one thing completely instead of four things partly.
Harder — Telling your own preference apart from everyone else’s.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Venus faces you from Libra: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is on home ground in Libra. Mercury faces you from Scorpio, holding the other figures. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. Four weeks of Scorpio ended, and nothing carried over.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Mars sextiles you from Leo: an opening to be reached for. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, falls in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Water that starts things, started cheaply. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Scorpio squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Moon in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Retrograde since three weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you from Libra, a sign it owns outright. Mars in Leo opens a gap you have to step into. Air moves first here, and first is enough. Two weeks ago Venus was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. Mercury is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds until owning and being coincide. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Libra, Venus hands you an opening. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, has no support in Aries and asks twice for half. Mercury squares you from Scorpio, and the cost objects. Fixed air pays to hold on. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Moon in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The trine to Moon that held two weeks ago has let go.
